description:
Final implementation-phase ticket. Run a reduced subset of the N-008 §22 smoke suite against the MVP built in T-011..T-020 on M1, fix any blocking defects discovered, and produce a "ready for T-010c" verdict. This ticket exists to catch implementation gaps before T-010c spins up the full matrix (M1+M2+M3+M4) and burns wall-clock time on RC execution.

Scope (binding):
- Use T-010a's runner harness against the helper from T-019 + Electron from T-020 on M1. If T-010a is not yet runnable, hand-run the equivalent JSON-RPC sequences using `socat` or a thin throwaway script and capture the evidence bundle from N-008 §7 manually.
- Run the MVP-relevant subset of the smoke suite (N-008 §22), in order, stopping on first must-pass red. Specifically execute:
  1. Env probe (`window.coveApi.env.probe`) — must report `pipewire`, `xdg-desktop-portal`, GPU vendor.
  2. `capture.sessionReady` after portal pick (M1, monitor mode).
  3. Portal denial (cancel picker) → `capture.sessionLost { reason: "portal-denied" }`.
  4. 1080p60 NVENC 60 s recording → ffprobe reports `≈ 3600 frames ± 60`, `codec h264`, faststart.
  5. Issue #3 proof: minimise window for 60 s during recording → frame count matches elapsed time × declared fps.
  6. NVENC probe + `encoder.selected` visibility.
  7. 60 s recording + `replay.save({durationSeconds: 30})` + `replay.export_start` → playable MP4 within 5 s.
  8. No fake duplicated frames in the exported MP4 (ffprobe `-show_frames` check; duplicated-PTS pairs ≤ 1/60 s per N-008 §6).
  9. Export concurrent with `RECORDING` → capture `dropped_since_last` stays within 2× pre-export baseline.
  10. Issue #4 proof: HUD ticks at ≥ 1 Hz during `SAVING` (sampled from event arrival cadence).
  11. `saveReplay` hotkey path.
  12. After IDLE → RECORDING → quit, `pgrep cove-replay-engine|ffmpeg|pactl -u $UID` returns zero rows 5 s later.
  13. `pactl` never spawned by helper or its children (`ps --ppid $(pgrep cove-replay-engine) -o comm=` during recording → no `pactl`).
- Rows from N-008 §22 that the MVP CANNOT cover (region overlay if T-016 region mode is deferred, full matrix coverage, 1440p60/4K60 must-pass) are deliberately SKIPPED with a clear "deferred to T-010c" marker.
- For every fail discovered, file a storybloq issue under the owner_on_fail layer (capture / encoder / segment / export / ui / supervision per N-008 §3) and route it to the appropriate ticket (T-016 for capture, T-017 for encoder, etc.). Do NOT patch in this ticket — the failed-layer ticket reopens.
- Produce an MVP smoke report:
  - `.story/handovers/<date>-XX-mvp-smoke.md` listing each row, pass/fail, evidence path, and a `Ready for T-010c?` verdict (`green` | `red` | `partial — see open issues`).
  - The evidence bundle per N-008 §7 is collected per passing row (engine.diagnosticsBundle.zip, ffprobe.json, mediainfo.json, renderer-events.jsonl, pre/post_pgrep.txt).
- Flip the `COVE_V2_UI=1` gate from T-020 to default-on if it was added.
- Unblock T-010c by removing the placeholder `blockedBy: ["T-010a", "T-010b"]` augmentation that this ticket added (see T-010c update under "Cross-ticket changes" below).

Cross-ticket changes (binding, planning-side only):
- After T-021 produces a `green` verdict, T-010c becomes the next executable ticket. Its current `blockedBy: ["T-010a", "T-010b"]` is augmented by this ticket to `["T-010a", "T-010b", "T-021"]` — the .story update happens at the same time T-021 is opened, NOT at T-021 completion. Mark T-021 explicitly as the "v2 implementation RC candidate gate" in its description.

Out of scope (binding):
- No M2/M3/M4/M5 testing — T-010c.
- No 1440p60 / 4K60 must-pass attempt — T-010c.
- No regression suite execution — T-010c.
- No v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison plot — T-010c.
- No packaging audit — T-010d.
- No release publish — T-010e.
- No patches to T-011..T-020. Defects found here re-open their owning ticket.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The 13-row MVP smoke subset above runs end-to-end on M1.
2. Every row produces an evidence bundle per N-008 §7.
3. A markdown report is filed under `.story/handovers/` with row-by-row pass/fail and the `Ready for T-010c?` verdict.
4. Any must-pass red blocks the verdict (`red` or `partial`) and a storybloq issue is filed against the owner_on_fail layer with a link back to the responsible ticket (T-016..T-020).
5. The "Issue #3 absorption" row (minimised window) passes — load-bearing for the v2.0.0 thesis.
6. The "no fake duplicated frames" row passes — load-bearing for the v1.1.0 regression kill.
7. The "pactl never spawned" row passes.

Verification commands:
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine --release`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run typecheck`
- Manual on M1: drive the 13-row subset.
- `find .story/handovers/ -name '*mvp-smoke*' -mtime -1` shows the new report.
- `git status --short`

Codex review expectations:
- This ticket produces a verdict, not source changes. Codex review is needed ONLY if defects discovered in T-021 require patching T-011..T-020 — in which case review happens against the owning ticket.
- For the report itself, Codex review confirms: rows match N-008 §22 subset above, evidence bundle is complete, verdict is justified by the data.

Failure handling:
- If a row fails, STOP. File the issue against the owner_on_fail layer. Re-open the responsible ticket (T-016..T-020). Do not attempt to patch in this ticket.
- If two re-opens of the same owning ticket fail to resolve the same row, escalate per WORKFLOW.md "Failed fix reset" — recommend a fresh implementation session against that ticket using the current handover + diagnostics bundle.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: Run MVP smoke validation on helper + Electron; prepare for T-010c
